note: Public identifiers only. Ramp figures are EUR and change; read Ramp's list live (H16: a ZIGoals server route) rather than shipping these numbers. Codes: Ramp CHAIN_SYMBOL from its docs table; Banxa coinType/blockchain from its coin table. walletAddressFormat is derived from the network, not a provider field.

hostApiKey.note: "A required string parameter that allows our system to properly recognize and count purchases"; without it the widget answers INTEGRATION ISSUE DETECTED (probed 2026-10-18T22:40Z, demo and production)

userAddress.accepts: an address on the chain of the chosen asset (cosmos1… for COSMOS_ATOM — not verified without a key)

enabledCryptoAssets.accepts: CHAIN_SYMBOL codes, e.g. BASE_USDC, COSMOS_ATOM; first = default; replaces swapAsset/offrampAsset

outAsset.accepts: ONRAMP: the crypto code received, e.g. BASE_USDC (replaces defaultAsset)

inAsset.accepts: ONRAMP: the fiat paid, e.g. EUR (replaces fiatCurrency)

inAssetValue.accepts: ONRAMP: fiat in cents, "10.00" EUR -> "1000" (replaces fiatValue)

outAssetValue.accepts: ONRAMP: crypto in base units (replaces swapAmount)

enabledFlows.accepts: comma-separated ONRAMP,OFFRAMP in hosted mode (default ONRAMP)

paymentMethodType.accepts: MANUAL_BANK_TRANSFER | AUTO_BANK_TRANSFER | PIX | APPLE_PAY | GOOGLE_PAY | CARD_PAYMENT (on-ramp only)

finalUrl.accepts: https URL; hosted mode and on-ramp only; redirect after completing the flow

successUrl.accepts: https URL; "Back to partner" button on success screens, opens a new tab

failureUrl.accepts: https URL; "Back to partner" on failure screens, opens a new tab

userEmailAddress.zigoals: do not use (personal data in a URL)

variant.accepts: auto | hosted | desktop | mobile | hosted-mobile | webview-desktop | webview-mobile | embedded-mobile | embedded-desktop (SDK)

url.accepts: SDK only: a non-production widget, e.g. https://app.demo.rampnetwork.com

list.liveLookup: the cryptocurrency lookup endpoint of the API reference (needs the partner's x-api-key)

_base.partnerRef: partner subdomain provided by Banxa during onboarding

params._rules: "All parameters are optional." "Parameter names are case-sensitive". Payment method cannot be pre-selected. No server-to-server call, no webhooks in referral mode.

coinType.accepts: the Code column of the coin table, e.g. ATOM, USDC

blockchain.accepts: the Network column of the coin table, e.g. ETH, BASE, ARB, SOL, ATOM; default network for the coin if omitted

walletAddress.accepts: the person's address on that network (URL-encoded)

walletAddressTag.accepts: memo/tag for chains that need one (BNB, XRP …)

returnUrl.accepts: URL-encoded URL; redirect on complete or cancel
returnUrl.source: https://docs.banxa.com/products/hosted-checkout/docs/referral-integration/supported-parameters.md; also the referral overview and the legacy referral-link page

redirectUrl.note: NOT a referral parameter: it is the required body field of POST /v2/buy (API integration) and the name used on the redirect/web, redirecting-to-checkout and customer-journey pages, which describe API-created orders
